prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Unity, Swarmer. The one reference defines creature identity/silhouette and view. Redraw continuous actions of this same creature. Matte dark brown rock armor, pale gray-white tendon limbs, restrained amber eye slit, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45-degree game camera, upper-left soft light. Very low, flat, small quadruped scout with one broad smooth wedge-shaped brown rocky carapace covering its back, small pointed front head with a narrow amber eye slit, pale gray tendon limbs splayed laterally, FOUR limbs only. No dorsal organs, no horns, no tall ridges. Keep the low turtle/beetle silhouette of the reference.
Direction ALL frames: REAR view facing straight away toward TOP center, rear legs nearest viewer, back armor dominates, no front-facing eye slit; every pose is strictly back view, never turn. No angle changes during skill or death.
Strict layout FOUR columns x 4 rows = 16 separate full drawings. Square canvas, width-to-height ratio 4:4. IMPORTANT: not landscape. Empty transparent margin takes 20 percent on every side of EVERY cell, including space between rows. Full silhouettes including legs must NEVER touch adjacent poses. All drawings same scale, central placement and foot baseline. Rows1-2: EIGHT distinct sequential WALK frames, alternating diagonal foot pairs lift and plant with a continuous scuttling gait, torso stays nearly level. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breathing poses, planted feet, subtle living tissues, no whole-body scaling. Row4: FOUR distinct DEATH poses: legs progressively buckle, carapace settles onto floor, head rests, eye goes dark; a quiet non-explosive collapse.
Real articulated movement, no exact duplicate or transformed still frames. Four legs, single head, consistent anatomy and armor. True alpha0 transparent empty canvas including gaps inside limbs; no floor, shadow, opaque backdrop, text, labels, grid, particles or projectiles.
